reason: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb, the new unsubscribe action calls `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` (patch line 204) and then calls `tu.notification_level` (line 206) without a nil check. TopicView.new does not create a topic_users row (lib/topic_view.rb never references TopicUser), so a logged-in user with no row for that topic, such as one following an email link for a topic they never opened, gets a NoMethodError and a 500.
